alt: Exercise 3.2 · Q11: A shopping mall has 150 employees labelled 1 to 150, representing the Universal set U. The employees fall into the following categories:; Set A: 40 employees with a salary range of 30k-45k, labelled from 50 to 89.; Set B: 50 employees with a salary range of 50k-80k, labelled from 101 to 150.; Set C: 60 employees with a salary range of 100k-150k, labelled from 1 to 49 and 90 to 100. (a) Find (A′ ∪ B′) ∩ C (b) Find n{A ∩ (B′ ∩ C′)}

steps.title: Set up
steps.text: \[\begin{aligned}&U=\{1,2,3,\ldots ,150\}\\[5pt]&A=\{50,51,\ldots ,89\},\text{ n(A) }=40\\[5pt]&B=\{101,102,\ldots ,150\},\text{ n(B) }=50\\[5pt]&C=\{1,2,\ldots ,49\}\cup \{90,91,\ldots ,100\},\\[5pt]&\quad \text{n(C) }=49+11=60\\[5pt]&\text{The three sets are pairwise}\\[5pt]&\quad \textcolor{#047857}{\textbf{disjoint}}\text{ (no label is in two sets)}\\[5pt]&\quad \text{and }40+50+60=150,\text{ so }A\cup B\cup C=\\[5pt]&\quad \text{U.}\end{aligned}\]

steps.title: Part (a)
steps.text: \[\begin{aligned}&\text{(a) By De Morgan's law, }A'\cup B'=\\[5pt]&\quad \text{(A }\cap B)'\\[5pt]&\quad \text{A $\cap$ B = $\phi$, so (A $\cap$ B)$'$ = $\phi$$'$ = U}\\[5pt]&\quad (A'\cup B')\cap C=U\cap C\\[5pt]&\quad =C\\[5pt]&\quad =\{1,2,\ldots ,49,90,91,\ldots ,100\}\\[5pt]&\quad (60\text{ elements)}\end{aligned}\]

steps.title: Part (b)
steps.text: \[\begin{aligned}&\text{(b) }B'\cap C'=\text{ (B }\cup C)'=U-\text{ (B }\cup \text{ C)}\\[5pt]&\quad \text{Since }A\cup B\cup C=U\text{ with A, B, C}\\[5pt]&\quad \text{disjoint, }U-\text{ (B }\cup \text{ C) }=A\\[5pt]&\quad A\cap (B'\cap C')=A\cap A=A\\[5pt]&\quad \therefore n\{A\cap (B'\cap C')\}=\text{ n(A) }=\text{ }\textcolor{#047857}{\mathbf{40}}\end{aligned}\]
